summary: The new object printer rejects trees at its nesting limit, and the old harness prints only parser-produced trees. The delegated build configuration is missing, so the configured limit and feasibility of the frozen candidate cannot be established.
missing_information: The delegated fuzz build configuration is needed to establish the compiled CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT and whether a tree at that limit is feasible.

claims.necessity_reason: The added guard and the harness's parser-only route support the proposed coverage gap if the configured nesting limit permits a feasible constructed tree. The supplied build script delegates to an unread recipe, so that premise is unresolved.

before.requirement: Reach the object printer's depth-limit rejection for a constructed object tree.
before.reason: The complete old object printer has no depth-limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the object printer's rejection for a constructed object at the compiled CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
after.reason: The new printer rejects an object at the limit, while parsing rejects containers at that same depth and the harness prints only successful parses. The delegated build configuration is missing, so a feasible configured threshold is not established.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object parsing rejects a container at the same limit.
Array parsing also rejects a container at the limit, preventing mixed nesting from reaching the printer guard.
Defines the default limit conditionally; the delegated build may override it.
Public insertion can connect constructed object nodes.
The public constructor creates object nodes.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The harness build invokes the unread delegated fuzz build recipe.

claims.comparison_reason: The old printer lacks this rejection; the new printer adds it. The old harness has no construction path, but the missing build configuration prevents a definitive feasibility assessment.
missing_information: The effective CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT and target compilation settings in fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh and fuzzing/CMakeLists.txt.
